title: The Request Line
hook: The old night host left one note on the microphone: if the request line lights up after three, don't answer.
lines: Nobody listens to a tiny country radio station at three in the morning. At least, that's what I thought.
The old night host left one sticky note on my microphone.
If the request line lights up after three... don't answer. And never put the caller on the air.
All winter, that line stayed dark. Just me, the snow, and sad old songs.
Then, one night, at three-oh-six... the little red light started blinking.
I let it ring. Through two whole songs.
Then it stopped... and so did the music.
I grabbed my headphones. And I heard my own voice. Live. On the air.
We've got a caller on the line, folks. Go ahead... you're on.
Something breathed into the line. Slow. Wet. Patient.
Then it asked for a dedication... for the man alone in the studio.
Tell him I'm on the stairs.
I yanked every cable out of the board. Dead air. Total silence.
Then the stairwell door creaked open behind me... and my own voice whispered... You're on.
